style.backgroundSystem: two-tone mist pink #F7C6D0 with a deeper coral band #E8899B for hero shots, clean white #FFFFFF and warm greige #F4F1EE for info shots, seamless coral #E8637B for the closing shot
style.direction: soft pink autumn-winter hand care commerce
style.iconSystem: thin-line icons and numbered circles in a single coral accent #E8637B
style.lightingSystem: warm soft studio lighting, gentle front or front-left key, soft contact shadows, controlled highlights, no harsh speculars
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent soft pink autumn-winter hand care visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of mist pink background #F7C6D0, coral red accent #E8637B, clean white #FFFFFF and charcoal text #3B3B3D; warm soft studio lighting with a gentle front key and soft contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif with rounded capsule labels; consistent thin-line icon style; clean high-end hand-cream photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable upright tube presentation at a consistent hero angle and scale; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
style.presentationRules: stable upright tube at a slight 3/4 or straight-on hero angle, consistent scale across the set
style.surfaceSystem: matte round podium, smooth seamless paper backdrops and a light grey matte board #F5F4F2
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif, rounded capsule labels, short headers only
